description: Find vacation rentals in a municipality or region (Italy, Germany, Spain, France, Portugal) for a number of guests. Where: municipality, province, (Italy) region, or a radius around an Italian municipality (near) or a point (latitude/longitude), each hit with its straight-line distance; the order stays tier, then name, sort by distance yourself. Criteria: capacity, bedrooms, bathrooms, amenities (a fixed table of names incl. pool facets such as private or heated, otherwise exact), what is rented, pets allowed, highest indicative price and, with from/to, dates not blocked in the operator's synced calendar. A stated fact that contradicts a criterion always leaves the property out. Each hit lists the criteria a stated fact meets in matched and says match (every criterion met) or possible, with the open points in unknown: by default only availability on request and a heated pool's heating on the requested dates; with include_possible also any fact the operator did not state (no current calendar is never read as free). Ask the operator about every point in unknown before relying on it. At most 20 results, ordered by the strongest free tier, then name (with include_possible matches first); the paid tier L5 does not change the order. No ranking by anything else, no fuzzy matching. Each result has priceFrom (indicative, negotiated directly, no booking) and the next window not blocked in the operator's calendar. Availability is a hint, never a booking commitment: a night not blocked in the operator's synced calendar may already be taken, since the calendar is a copy that can lag behind; only the operator confirms availability, and Ospitario holds or books nothing. Prices are indicative, stated by the host (on an unclaimed passport: taken from the official website), negotiated directly with the host; there is no booking through Ospitario. Every result is a property with a proven listing (L2/L2c), a verified operator (L3), a right to manage verified by document review (LA) or, marked L0 and unclaimed, facts from the operator's official website with nothing proven; the result names the tier and the date it was reached, and whether the registration number (Italy: CIN) was checked against the public register. Contact is direct with the operator and commission-free, so the traveler pays no platform fee. No result means nothing proven matches; nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in.

amenities.description: Every listed amenity must be present. These names match the operator's wording in any of the six languages through a fixed table: pool, wifi, parking, airConditioning (ac), garden, seaView, terrace, kitchen, washingMachine (washerDryer), bbq (outdoorGrill), heating, fireplace, balcony, tv, hotTub, elevator, crib, microwave, workspace. A pool can be asked with its facets: "private pool", "shared pool", "heated pool", "indoor pool", "outdoor pool" (or the same words in Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French); a facet the operator did not state is unknown, not a match. Any other word must match an amenity exactly (case-insensitive).

bathrooms.description: Minimum number of bathrooms; a half bath counts 0.5

children.description: true: only properties whose operator states that children are welcome

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: IT, DE, ES, FR or PT

guests.description: Number of guests; properties with a lower capacity are left out. Optional since 1.14.0: without it, capacity is not a criterion

include_possible.description: true: also return possible matches, where a requested fact is not stated (capacity, bedrooms, an amenity or pool facet, pets, price, current calendar) and nothing stated contradicts the request; each hit names the open points in unknown. Default false: only hits that meet every criterion, plus availability on request.

lang.description: Language of labels in the result; defaults to en

latitude.description: Point to search around, WGS 84 degrees; with longitude and radiusKm, instead of near

longitude.description: Point to search around, WGS 84 degrees; with latitude

maxPrice.description: Highest indicative price per night in EUR: properties whose lowest current or future priceFrom is above it, or that gave no price, are left out

near.description: Italian municipality to search around, by name (e.g. Lecce); with radiusKm. A name several municipalities carry needs nearProvince

nearProvince.description: Province code of near when the name is ambiguous (e.g. LE)

pets.description: true: only properties whose operator states that pets are allowed

placeKind.description: entire, private_room or shared_room; properties that did not state it are left out

propertyKind.description: Kind of building: apartment, house, villa, farmhouse, trullo, cottage, chalet, other; a property that did not state it is open (unknown: propertyKind), another kind leaves it out

province.description: Region code within the country, ISO 3166-2 without the prefix: IT/ES province (LE), FR département (75), DE Land (HH), PT distrito (11)

radiusKm.description: Radius around near or latitude/longitude in km, straight line, default 20. A passport counts at its published exact location, else at its municipality's centre (computed from Istat's boundaries), so a home just inside a municipality can lie a few km off; every hit names its distance and basis. Municipality centres computed by Ospitario from Istat, Confini delle unità amministrative a fini statistici al 1° gennaio 2026 (CC BY 4.0)

region.description: Italian region, by its Italian name or slug (Abruzzo, Basilicata, Calabria, Campania, Emilia-Romagna, Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Lazio, Liguria, Lombardia, Marche, Molise, Piemonte, Puglia, Sardegna, Sicilia, Toscana, Trentino-Alto Adige, Umbria, Valle d’Aosta, Veneto); the usual English, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese names are understood too (Apulia, Toskana). Italy only; matches the passport's province

stepFree.description: true: only properties whose operator states step-free access

name: search_properties

amenities.description: Amenities in the operator's own words

lastSync.description: Last successful calendar sync, ISO timestamp

status.description: calendar: blocked dates come from the operator's calendar, synced recently (lastSync); unblocked nights are not confirmed free; on_request: the operator answers availability on request, no dates are published; unknown: no current calendar, ask the operator. Availability is a hint, never a booking commitment: a night not blocked in the operator's synced calendar may already be taken, since the calendar is a copy that can lag behind; only the operator confirms availability, and Ospitario holds or books nothing.

bathrooms.description: Bathrooms; a half bath counts 0.5. null: not stated.

booking.description: What a traveler can do with this passport: contact the operator, never book through Ospitario. Availability is separate (availability, blocked)

bookable.description: Always false: Ospitario takes no bookings and no payment. A result, a free night or a sent inquiry reserves nothing; the operator confirms dates and price

contact.description: direct: the operator's own channels are in contact, and send_inquiry mails the operator; relay_only: unclaimed, write with send_inquiry (the official website in contact.site is the operator's own page, not an inquiry channel of Ospitario). send_inquiry may still refuse, with a reason

childrenAllowed.description: Whether children are welcome, as the operator states it; null: not stated

contactPageUrl.description: Page with the passport and the operator's direct contact; give this link to the traveler

from.description: location: the exact location the operator published; municipality_centre: the centre of the passport's municipality (Istat boundaries), the home itself may lie a few km off

km.description: Straight-line distance in whole km; not a driving distance

distance.description: From the requested point (near: that municipality's centre) to the passport; null without near or latitude/longitude

match.description: match: every criterion is met by a stated fact; possible: nothing stated contradicts the request, but the points in unknown are open. Properties that contradict a criterion are never returned

matched.description: Criteria of this request that a stated fact meets, named as in unknown: country, municipality, province, region, near (within radiusKm), guests, bedrooms, bathrooms, an amenity word as asked, "pool open on the requested dates", "pool heating on the requested dates", placeKind, pets, children, stepFree, minNights, price, availability (free in a current calendar). Computed from the passport's data, never generated

minNights.description: Minimum stay in nights as the operator states it; null: not stated, ask the operator

to.description: Checkout day when the next blocked night begins, YYYY-MM-DD; null: free to the end of the calendar horizon

nextFreeWindow.description: First span not blocked in the operator's synced calendar from the requested check-in (or today) that is at least as long as the requested stay; null when the calendar is not current or on request. Not a booking commitment: ask the operator to confirm.

petsAllowed.description: Whether pets are allowed, as the operator states it; null: not stated, ask the operator.

placeKind.description: What the guest rents: the entire place, a private room or a shared room. Declared by the operator; null: not stated.

pool.description: The pool, facet by facet; null: not stated. Never inferred.

access.description: null: not stated, or the lines disagree

heated.description: true: a heated or heatable pool. It does not say the pool is heated on given dates: see heatedSeason and heating. null: not stated

heatedSeason.description: Days the pool is heated every year, MM-DD to MM-DD; null: not declared, or several periods (see heatedSeasons)

heatedSeasons.description: Every period the pool is heated each year; empty: not declared

heating.description: As the operator declares it: no heating, heating included, heating for a surcharge, heating on request (notice in notes); null: not declared

notes.description: Conditions in the operator's words: surcharge, notice for heating, hours, age rules

present.description: true: the operator declares a pool, or a line names a pool of the house; false: declared or stated absent; null: not stated

season.description: Days the pool is open every year, MM-DD to MM-DD inclusive (may run across New Year); null when several periods are declared (see seasons); null: not declared, ask the operator

seasons.description: Every period the pool is open each year, as the operator declares them; empty: not declared, ask the operator

source.description: operator: declared in the passport's pool fields; amenity_text: read from the amenity lines by fixed patterns in six languages, a line that places the pool elsewhere (public, nearby) does not count; null: nothing about a pool

anyOf.description: Indicative price per night. Prices are indicative, stated by the host (on an unclaimed passport: taken from the official website), negotiated directly with the host; there is no booking through Ospitario. null: the operator gave no price.

nightlyFrom.description: Lowest nightly price among the current and future periods

seasons.description: Current and future periods; ended ones are left out

nightlyFrom.description: Lowest nightly price the operator states for this period

seasonLabel.description: Season name in the operator's words

validFrom.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; null: no start given

validTo.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; null: no end given

updatedAt.description: When the operator last changed the prices, YYYY-MM-DD

province.description: Region code, ISO 3166-2 without the country prefix: IT/ES province (LE, GR), FR département (75), DE Land (HH), PT distrito (11)

stepFreeAccess.description: Whether the home can be entered without steps, as the operator states it; null: not stated. Not an accessibility certification

type.description: Accommodation type as stated by the operator

unclaimed.description: true: an unclaimed passport (tier L0) built from the operator's official website; email and phone are not shown, write with send_inquiry

unknown.description: Criteria no stated fact settles, e.g. guests, bedrooms, availability, pets, price, an amenity word, "pool heating on the requested dates"; ask the operator about these before relying on them

date.description: Date the tier was reached, YYYY-MM-DD

tier.description: Verification tier (docs: ADR 0012, 0017, 0024, 0025). L0 unclaimed: facts read from the operator's official website, nothing proven, the operator has not claimed the page; contact only through send_inquiry. L2 listing verified: the operator proved control of the platform listing (calendar export link with the listing id, platform email with a valid DKIM signature, or channel manager); since 2026-11-07 also their right to manage the property (LA or L3), and earlier L2 stands as it was reached. L2c listing calendar proven (Booking, Vrbo): the operator blocked a random date Ospitario named in that platform's calendar export within 48 hours; no new L2c since 2026-11-07. LA right-to-manage documents reviewed: Ospitario's admin checked documents tying the operator to this property (registration record, deed, lease, mandate or company register); a person found them consistent, without eID, so it does not prove who holds the account and never proves a platform listing. L3 operator verified: the operator's eID identity (SPID/CIE) matches the CIN holder in the national register's PDF. L4 document verified (automated check): an ownership, lease or mandate document is consistent with that identity and the property; it states consistency, not authenticity. L5 manually verified: a reviewer checked the document (an optional upgrade; it does not affect search order).
